title: Sonu Sood Leases Versova Commercial Unit For Rs 3.52 Crore Over Five Years
excerpt: Registration documents reviewed by Square Yards show a five-year letting in Aram Nagar, Versova, with rent starting at Rs. 5 lakh a month and rising about 8% a year to Rs. 6.80 lakh.
body:
• Sonu Sood has rented out a commercial unit in Aram Nagar, Versova, Andheri West, Mumbai, in a deal registered in October 2026.
  • The Rs. 3.52 crore figure is the total rental value over the five-year term, not a sale price or a monthly rent.
  • Rent starts at Rs. 5 lakh a month and rises by about 8% a year, reaching Rs. 6.80 lakh a month in the fifth year.
  • The agreement carries a security deposit of Rs. 32 lakh, stamp duty of Rs. 93,000 and registration charges of Rs. 1,000.

Actor Sonu Sood has rented out a commercial unit in Mumbai's Versova area in a transaction with a total rental value of Rs. 3.52 crore over five years, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards and reported by Bollywood Hungama. The transaction was registered in October 2026, with the details available on the website of the Maharashtra Inspector General of Registration (IGR). A second report of the same registration documents, published by Constro Facilitator, confirms the same total, location and rental schedule.

Context

The commercial property is located in Aram Nagar, Versova, which falls under Andheri West, according to both reports. Versova is a coastal locality in Mumbai's western suburbs and is known for its residential developments and its proximity to the entertainment industry. Bollywood Hungama noted that the area is connected to other parts of the city through Link Road, SV Road and the Western Express Highway, with the Versova Metro station and Andheri railway station providing further access. The locality offers access to business hubs including Andheri East, Goregaon and Bandra Kurla Complex, and its social infrastructure includes Versova Beach, cafes, restaurants, retail outlets, educational institutions and healthcare facilities. Both reports noted that the proposed Versova-Bandra Sea Link is expected to improve connectivity across Mumbai's western suburbs once completed. That combination of coastal setting, entertainment-industry presence and improving transport links has made Versova a preferred location for professionals and families, and it provides the setting for a five-year commercial lease of this size.

Impact

The rental schedule in the registered documents sets out exactly how the Rs. 3.52 crore total is reached. The monthly rent is Rs. 5 lakh for the first year, rising to Rs. 5.40 lakh in the second year, Rs. 5.83 lakh in the third year, Rs. 6.29 lakh in the fourth year and Rs. 6.80 lakh in the fifth year, according to Bollywood Hungama; Constro Facilitator gives the same schedule with exact figures of Rs. 5,83,200, Rs. 6,29,860 and Rs. 6,80,240 for years three to five. Both reports describe the structure as an annual escalation of approximately 8%. The agreement also includes a security deposit of Rs. 32 lakh, and the transaction involved a stamp duty payment of Rs. 93,000 and registration charges of Rs. 1,000. The deal adds a documented commercial letting to Sood's public record in Mumbai real estate. Beyond property, Sood has worked as an actor and film producer across Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and Kannada cinema, and he received wide attention for his humanitarian efforts during the COVID-19 pandemic, when he helped stranded migrant workers and students return to their hometowns, Bollywood Hungama noted. Through the Sood Charity Foundation, he continues to support initiatives in education, healthcare and social welfare; Constro Facilitator also noted that he received the United Nations Development Programme's SDG Special Humanitarian Action Award in 2020.

"3.52 crore over five years, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards and reported by Bollywood Hungama ."

What's Next

Under the registered terms, the lease now runs for its five-year term, with the monthly rent stepping up by about 8% each year from the Rs. 5 lakh starting point to Rs. 6.80 lakh in the final year. No tenant for the Versova unit was named in either report, and neither report gave the size of the unit, so those details remain undisclosed in the registration-based coverage. What the documents do establish clearly is the structure of the deal itself: a five-year letting in Aram Nagar, a Rs. 32 lakh deposit, and a total contracted rent of Rs. 3.52 crore across the full term.
